title: What Mountain Gravity Storage Is
definition: Mountain Gravity Storage: using mountainsides as giant gravity batteries.
description:
Mountain Gravity Storage: using mountainsides as giant gravity batteries. This is Future Energy Systems at its most ambitious — rail weights research, mountain logistics engineering and track engineering operations converging on a single goal: making mountain hulls real.

Why it matters: Future Energy Systems will decide environmental care outcomes this century. Mountain Gravity Storage is one of the load-bearing ideas: without working mountain hulls, the larger rail weights vision stalls, and with it, the mountain logistics systems that depend on it.

This database documents Mountain Gravity Storage in full: what it is, the real research behind it today, the pieces it is built from, dated forecasts, runnable demo programs, and a teaching ladder from foundations to mastery. Every record carries a working program you can run.

t: Real Research Today: Mountain Gravity Storage
title: Real Research Today: Mountain Gravity Storage
definition: Today's documented research behind Mountain Gravity Storage.
description:
The road to Mountain Gravity Storage is already being paved. The International Energy Agency tracks 500+ GW of annual solar additions in its net-zero scenarios. The US National Ignition Facility achieved fusion ignition (net energy gain) in December 2022.

Small modular reactor designs (NuScale, Rolls-Royce SMR) move through licensing worldwide. Together these programs form the rail weights foundation that Mountain Gravity Storage will build on — the mountain logistics results, the track engineering methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as mountain logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: Readiness Estimator: Mountain Gravity Storage
definition: Estimates Mountain Gravity Storage readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Mountain Gravity Storage components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a mountain hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Mountain Gravity Storage Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Mountain Gravity Storage operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Mountain Gravity Storage installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 82825 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where rail weights monitoring, mountain logistics redundancy, or track engineering maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Mountain Gravity Storage Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Mountain Gravity Storage: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Mountain Gravity Storage — using mountainsides as giant gravity batteries.

Phase 1 — Prove (rail weights): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (mountain logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (track engineering): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (environmental care): mountain hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and highlands-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
